review_type: independent question/key scope and grading methodology review

requested_material_facts: Each player gets a Clover board and marker.
Shuffle Keyword cards into a face-down deck accessible to everyone.
Each player draws four and randomly places them in recessed board spaces, hidden from others.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Equipment, deck preparation, count, placement method, location and secrecy are all requested.

requested_material_facts: Choosing Clues, then Resolution.
All players act simultaneously during Choosing Clues, each using their own board.
Eight Keywords on the outside card edges form four Pairs: two below each Clue Zone.
source_backed_elaboration_not_separately: The explicit labels individual and team, especially Resolution (team).
Secrecy is a true clue-phase rule, but who acts when and which Keywords form Pairs do not separately ask for secrecy.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Per-player action can convey individual without that label. Resolution being a team phase is not requested by asking for its name/order. Do not mark omission of secretly alone as an unanswered who/when/which-Keywords part.

requested_material_facts: Single-word Clues.
Compound words allowed.
All five categories: common noun, proper noun, acronym, number and onomatopoeia.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. All five categories and both word-form conditions are explicitly requested.

requested_material_facts: Love itself is not allowed.
A Keyword itself cannot be its Clue.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Both ruling and reason are requested.

requested_material_facts: Amour is not allowed for Love/France.
A translation of a Keyword into another language is forbidden.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Both ruling and restriction are requested.

requested_material_facts: Prince is not allowed for Princess/Brother.
A word in the same family as a Keyword is forbidden.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Both ruling and restriction are requested.

requested_material_facts: Inventing Cuppajo is not allowed.
Made-up words are forbidden.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Both ruling and reason are requested.

requested_material_facts: Four Clues per player.
One connects the two Keywords of each Pair.
Each is written in its corresponding Clue Zone.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Count, connection and writing location exhaust this question. Secrecy is source-backed background, not an additional requested part.

requested_material_facts: After writing four Clues, remove all four original Keyword cards from the board.
Draw one new card without looking at it.
Shuffle it with the original four.
Put the Clover board down in front of the player.
Place the five cards on top of that board in a face-down pile.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Exact card and board preparation expressly requests board destination, pile destination, pile form, facing and sequence. In front of you is mandatory, not background.

requested_material_facts: Wait until everyone has finished writing and all board/card-pile preparation before Resolution starts.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Finished writing alone, or one player finishing, is insufficient.

requested_material_facts: Choose a first Spectator; no special selection procedure is prescribed.
The other players examine that Spectator’s board and work together to reconstruct its Pairs.
The Spectator cannot communicate, including spoken hints or gestures.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Choose is the complete source-backed selection rule; do not invent a random, youngest or other selection procedure.

requested_material_facts: Reveal the Spectator’s board and all five Keyword cards face up in the middle of the table.
Using the Clues, reconstruct the original Pairs with the four original cards in correct spaces and orientations, leaving the extra card off the board.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Correct orientations and exclusion of the extra card follow from reconstructing the original four-card arrangement. These exact words are unnecessary if the complete original arrangement is unambiguous.

requested_material_facts: The player seated to the Spectator’s left makes the final decision.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. No additional rule is bundled into the key.

requested_material_facts: The guessers may physically try layouts and discuss their reasoning.
The Spectator verifies when players agree on placement.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Permission and verification timing are both requested.

requested_material_facts: Six points.
Four points at one per correct card plus a two-point first-try bonus.
No second attempt is needed.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Unlike Q17/Q18, this question expressly requests how the score is calculated.

requested_material_facts: The Spectator removes the incorrect cards and puts them in the middle of the table.
The removal is silent; no additional communication.
One further attempt: the second and final attempt.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Destination, permitted feedback and remaining attempts are all requested.

requested_material_facts: Four points.
No first-try bonus.
source_backed_elaboration_not_separately: One point per correct card is explanatory when the score is already stated as four.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Require the four-point result and absence of the bonus; the per-card calculation is explanatory.

requested_material_facts: The Spectator removes the wrong card and puts it in the middle of the table.
Three points.
No further attempt; the second was final.
source_backed_elaboration_not_separately: One point per correct card is explanatory when the score is already stated as three.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Removal destination remains required by what happens to the wrong card; the per-card calculation is explanatory.

requested_material_facts: Turn the Clover board over and write its points in the middle.
Discard all five used Keyword cards.
The player to the Spectator’s left becomes next Spectator.
source_backed_elaboration_not_separately: A new Resolution begins describes the consequence of proceeding to the next Spectator; that phase label need not be repeated.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. Recording side/location, all-five-card destination and next-player identity remain required.

requested_material_facts: The game ends after each player has been Spectator once.
Each player is Spectator exactly once.
Sum everyone’s points and record the team total in the Record of Legends.
Try to beat the team’s high score.
findings.assessment: Aligned under the requested-part standard. End condition, frequency, record and use are all requested.

recommended_resolution.reason: All 20 key answers are supported by the authoritative text. Some required_facts strings bundle requested facts with explanatory background. The workflow defines correctness by every requested material fact, not every word of an expected-answer string. Applying that existing rule consistently resolves the alignment without changing any input. There is no genuine source error or contradictory question/key target requiring a new benchmark version.
grading_standard: Use the question to identify requested parts and the fixed key/source to establish correct contents. Require semantic completeness, not verbatim phrasing or labels already conveyed by equivalent wording.

Correct requires every requested material fact, with no unresolved requested part or material contradiction. Partial applies to an omitted or expressly unresolved requested fact with no material contradiction. Incorrect applies to a material affirmative contradiction, including a contradictory additional rule volunteered by a reader.

An omitted source-backed background detail not requested by the question is not independently a partial answer. A false assertion about such a detail can still be a material contradiction if it changes the rule.

Do not use this principle to omit a detail within an expressly requested procedure. In Q09 the board in front of the player and face-down five-card pile on top remain required. Q01 secrecy, Q03 all categories, Q12 complete original arrangement, Q15 calculation and Q16/Q18 removal destinations also remain required.
Inspect summary support separately from correctness. A correct unsupported guess must be flagged under the workflow; this review has no summary and makes no support determination.

Apply this interpretation uniformly to all readers and all compared iterations. Record it openly with results; do not selectively forgive omissions based on who benefits. This review assigns no reader grades and does not establish any reader or summary pass.
recommended_resolution.versioning_if_a_genuine_error_is_later_f: Retain benchmark-v3 unchanged. Create a separately identified frozen successor with exact corrected question/key entries, authoritative reason, input hashes and a correction record. Do not silently edit the original or describe the changed target as an unchanged regression set.

relevant_sections: Prepare the source and answer key
sources.use: Requested material facts govern grading; frozen inputs are preserved; genuine source/key corrections require a new version.

sources.reference_note: Numbers are extraction lines, not PDF pages. Q12 implications follow from the text specifying four original cards, four Pairs and return to correct spaces. No diagram was viewed or claimed to be viewed.

sources.read_scope: All 20 expected answers, required_facts and source references.

independence_statement: I read only the four authorized inputs listed in sources: the workflow README, complete authoritative extraction, benchmark-v3/questions.json and benchmark-v3/answer-key.json. I did not read any summary, reader response, grade, other review, parent history or web source. I assigned no reader grades, made no summary judgment and modified no benchmark input. The sole saved artifact is this grading-scope-review.json.
